title: Elephants First
can_do: 说出“我最喜欢……因为……”，也能给第二名一个理由。

conversation_move.label: state a favorite with a reason

trigger: Dad asks about favorite animals, and Child explains his rankings with reasons.
setting: A relaxed chat on the living-room sofa.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: What's your favorite animal at the zoo?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I like the elephants the most.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Why elephants, out of every animal?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Because they're big and gentle with their babies.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The penguins, because they slide on their bellies.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: If you could slide like that, would you?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes! But elephants can give rides, so elephants win.

replay_cards.title: Favorite fruit
replay_cards.change: Dad asks for a favorite and a second favorite.
replay_cards.challenge: Child names both with reasons and asks Dad's favorite back.

replay_cards.title: Favorite game
replay_cards.change: Grandma does not know Child's games.
replay_cards.challenge: Child names his favorite, gives a reason, and briefly says how the game works.

parent_support: 聊喜好时不满足于一个词的答案，追问“为什么最喜欢它”。
孩子给的理由再简单也接住，然后升级一问：“第二名是谁？”
反向问他“你猜爸爸最喜欢什么”，练习把问题抛回去。
